Log sheet for moulding of half pipe sections and dimensional inspection reports shall be shared along with each lot of half pipe section. 5. Moulding of half pipe sections are to be carried out as per processing document provided by VSSC. The document will be shared by VSSC to the vendor after PO placement. 6. Delivery Schedule: (a) Samples shall be submitted within 3 months from the date of receipt of FIM from VSSC (b).
